t.zh: <level-ref to="au-cert"></level-ref>里，外面的证明器交来证书，核照着重放。另一条路不要证书，靠核按定义去算。公式也能写成数据：Or p (Not p) 是一样东西；eval f a b 按定义算出它在 p 取 a、q 取 b 那一行的真假；taut f 把四行都算一遍。这样的程序叫<wiki-ref to="decision"></wiki-ref>，它判定一句话是不是永远成立。
t.en: In <level-ref to="au-cert"></level-ref> an outside prover handed over a certificate and the kernel replayed it. The other way needs no certificate and relies on the kernel computing by the definitions. A formula can be data too: Or p (Not p) is a thing; eval f a b works out by the definitions whether it is true on the row where p is a and q is b; taut f works out all four rows. Such a program is a <wiki-ref to="decision"></wiki-ref>: it decides whether a sentence always holds.

stated: ev(neg(z), x, y) = bnot(ev(z, x, y))
ev(conj(z, w), x, y) = band(ev(z, x, y), ev(w, x, y))
ev(disj(z, w), x, y) = bor(ev(z, x, y), ev(w, x, y))
taut(z) = band(ev(z, tt, tt), band(ev(z, tt, ff), band(ev(z, ff, tt), ev(z, ff, ff))))

brief.zh: 设计一个证明助手：每个目标都证出来。
brief.en: Design a proof assistant that proves every goal.

hint.zh: 这一关的定义都给化简用上。
hint.en: Give Simp every definition of this level.
